entry.title: Book of the month for October 2026: The Time Machine by H. G. Wells
entry.summary: A mysterious inventor travels to a land far off in time. One of the twenty most read books here, and rated 4.0 out of 5 on Open Library. More people are looking it up lately. A short one, about 2 hours to read.
